failure: Server rejected an event; see configuration and official protocol documentation
latency_basis: server speech_stopped receipt to first delta; excludes VAD detection delay; not acoustic end-to-end latency
pending: text_only: verify successful text response and no audio deltas
automatic_cancel: unknown because client always sends cancel
long_answer: review response lengths and content live
hourly_cost: usage recorded, regional prices and representative full-hour input required
